svg.title: Localization is performed on the scalar and current functions themselves: gauge fix along the prescribed finite axial paths, discard coordinates beyond the chosen radius, and retain the Taylor polynomial through order four in those local coordinates. Denote the localized tensor by Jloc, and localize Q, Ξ by the same operation. Restore its exact trace and its six antisymmetric divergences by defining X X eJ00 = ∇iQloc Jloc − ii , i i i̸=0
